title: Publish V4 Guards 1.1.5, the first release from the standalone Guard repository (V4-TODO-008 T6.7)
goal: Bump product metadata to 1.1.5 through a V4-judged pull request, certify the exact release commit on Linux and Windows, build a reproducible archive, publish an immutable GitHub Release from von12549/Guard, and verify it from a clean consumer environment, without runtime behavior change from 1.1.4.
acceptanceCriteria: The version-bump pull request passes v4-contract, v4-linux, v4-package, v4-windows and v4-required and an exact-head dispatch certification, and is merged by the operator.
Linux-complete and Windows-full certification of the exact release commit pass with one packageHash equal to the certified pull-request head.
Two distribution builds from clean worktrees with the same Host and Web Companion input produce a byte-identical v4-guards-1.1.5.zip and sidecar, and V1 candidate and recovery certification pass.
Annotated tag v4-guards-v1.1.5 and a final GitHub Release with exactly the archive and its SHA-256 sidecar are published without overwriting any ref or asset.

A fresh download matches the certified archive, installs, runs all four Stages on an external synthetic Target and uninstalls with a verified receipt; the records are updated through a V4-judged pull request.
risks: A release could be tagged on a commit other than the certified one.
Independent builds are location-dependent (O14); reproducibility is defined for the same Host and Companion input.
Publication is irreversible; any defect must be fixed by a new version.
decisions: Version 1.1.5 is the next unused version; IFX-hosted 1.0.0 through 1.1.4 stay immutable.
No runtime behavior change from 1.1.4; O8 and O14 are documented, not fixed, in this release.
Certify and tag the exact main merge commit; build the archive locally from a clean clone at that commit.
standaloneReleasePublished becomes true after verification; standaloneSourceAccepted waits for the T7 IFX handoff decision.
